issues.issue: Governmental insurance recoveries recorded as other_financing (as printed under Other Financing Sources), while the business-type 'Insurance recoveries' 526,552 (p6) is a receipt (reimbursements/refunds). The Statement of Activities (p2) counts both as general revenues. Defensible, but the same label is treated two ways.

Mixed-fund line. Depreciation and Repairs and maintenance were given the dominant fund's function (Arena, culture/recreation), but this one was not, although Arena is also dominant here. Judgment call (review flag already set).

Combined debt service is recorded as debt service principal / not itemized. p4 prints the principal/interest split for this fund, so detail_category 'debt principal' (or a split) could also be argued. Same for detail[20] Street Fund debt service 186,418 (170,000 + 16,418). Amounts are correct.
Cash held with trustee is in the Community Development Fund's fund balance and counts toward governmental ending cash 6,017,638. Category 'cash and investments' is also defensible.
